items.title: Oil prices fall and shares jump after US-Iran deal announced
items.description: Under the agreement, the key Strait of Hormuz waterway will be reopened, US President Donald Trump said.

items.title: Norwegian crown princess's son found guilty of two counts of rape
items.description: Marius Borg Høiby, the 29-year-old son of Norway's Crown Princess Mette Marit, has been sentenced to four years in jail.

items.title: Russian strikes kill 11 and set historic cathedral in Kyiv ablaze
items.description: A Ukrainian drone attack in the Russian city of Tula, south of Moscow, killed three people.

items.title: Brazil woman dies after rope-jumping instructors fail to attach cord
items.description: Three men have been arrested after instructors failed to attach a rope to her before helping her jump from a bridge.

items.title: US musician Oliver Tree dies in helicopter collision in Brazil
items.description: The singer-songwriter is among six people presumed dead in air crash over Rio de Janeiro on Sunday.

items.title: South Korea's Starbucks to shut for staff history lesson after backlash
items.description: The chain was criticised for a "Tank Day" marketing ploy on the anniversary of a military massacre.

items.title: 'Spider-Man of Yemen' dies falling into volcanic crater
items.description: Al-Qaqa Ibn Antar had been attempting to climb its walls without safety equipment when he fell in, local authorities say.

items.title: Man apologises for making racist gesture at Korean in World Cup match
items.description: He was caught pulling the corners of his eyes at a South Korean influencer during the match in Mexico.

items.title: China detains two leaders of influential underground church
items.description: More than 30 members of Early Rain Covenant Church were taken for interrogation midway through Sunday service.

items.title: South African TV star arrested after allegedly kidnapping man in girlfriend dispute
items.description: Molemo "Jub Jub" Maarohanye is accused of trapping a taxi driver in a car and firing a gun in the man's direction.

items.title: Teen shot and buses torched in Manhattan after historic NBA win for Knicks
items.description: At least 63 people were arrested in the disorder after the Knicks beat the Spurs to clinch the title.

items.title: Swiss voters reject 10 million population cap
items.description: Nearly 55% of participants voted against the proposal to cap population by cutting migration, results show.
